answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a comet counter-signature, and the beacon graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 15% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, recorded as a jade edge. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
